question.worked_solution:
The given repeating decimal can be expressed as

$$
\begin{aligned}0.4\overset{―}{25} & =0.425\,252\,5… \\  & =0.4+0.025+0.000\,25+0.000\,002\,5+… \\  & =0.4+(\frac{25}{1\,000}+\frac{25}{100\,000}+\frac{25}{10\,000\,000}+…).\end{aligned}
$$

The series in the parentheses is a geometric series with first term ${a}_{1}=\frac{25}{1\,000}$ and common ratio $r=\frac{1}{100}.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}0.4\overset{―}{25} & =0.4+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }{a}_{1}{r}^{n-1} \\  & =0.4+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{25}{1\,000}{(\frac{1}{100})}^{n-1} \\  & =0.4+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{25}{10}(\frac{1}{100}){(\frac{1}{100})}^{n-1} \\  & =0.4+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }2.5{(\frac{1}{100})}^{n}.\end{aligned}
$$
